## Standing operator rules
Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.

Operator: please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Operator: Never resolve a review thread tagged operator-1 unless @mara has replied in that thread during the current review cycle.

Operator: We already tried raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 to fix the sync timeouts. It caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging, so that approach is ruled out. Do not try it again.

Operator: Heads up: the staging database moved to db-stg-2.internal last week. db-stg-1 is a decommissioned read-only replica; config/staging.yaml is stale. Always use db-stg-2.

Operator: can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`.
Superseded: invoice pagination.

## Ruled-out approaches
Do not raise the SQLAlchemy pool to 50; it caused staging contention and deadlocks. Do not retry all `HTTPStatusError` responses; 4xx errors such as 422 must fail immediately.

## Recent work
CSV export now explicitly writes UTF-8; all tests passed (`186 passed, 3 skipped`). Added a small invoice type annotation and confirmed compilation. Next, inspect Stripe signature verification and add a regression test.

## Standing operator rules

## Current objective
Add pagination to GET /v1/invoices in `ledgerly/api/invoices.py`. Separately, run `enterprise-tenant-onboarding` between other work, executing steps 3–8 in order, one at a time; steps 1–2 are complete.

## Ruled-out approaches
Retrying all `HTTPStatusError` responses was rejected because 4xx responses such as 422 must fail immediately. Only `httpx.TransportError` and retryable server responses should retry.

## Recent work
Webhook delivery now supports bounded transport and server-error retries, max-attempt validation, capped backoff, and final-error propagation. Added retry tests; webhook suite has 8 passing tests, full suite 44 passing, and Ruff clean. Acme request validation and organization creation succeeded. Search index baseline: 18 passed, 2 failed because rebuilt documents miss recently updated invoice descriptions; indexing currently pages invoices and embeds each document serially, suggesting a latency bottleneck.
